WITH filtered_ab AS (
  SELECT * 
  FROM advancedbehavior
  WHERE peercorr >= 0.149
),
combinations AS (
  SELECT 
    fab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM filtered_ab fab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = fab.translink
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM combinations
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  c.translink,
  c.ordertypedist,
  c.count,
  c.count::NUMERIC / t.total_count as fraction
FROM combinations c
JOIN totals t ON c.ordertypedist = t.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
